WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS standings_records
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs
    ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(standings_records) AS avg_records
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT
  cc.constructorId,
  cc.nationality,
  cc.standings_records,
  cc.standings_records - ac.avg_records AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts AS cc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, cc.constructorId
LIMIT 10;
